channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Loop Dungeon - Incremental
item.description: Lead a party of heroes through endless dungeon loops. Gather loot, unlock permanent upgrades, and build powerful synergies as you push deeper into an ever-growing incremental adventure.

item.title: Touhou Mystia's Izakaya
item.description: A brand new pixel art restaurant simulator based on the Touhou Project! Play as Mystia, the owner of a small izakaya. Collect ingredients by day, cater to the customers by night, learn recipes from familiar characters, and become the best izakaya owner in all of Gensokyo!

item.title: Shadowrun: Dragonfall - Director's Cut
item.description: Harebrained Schemes' biggest Shadowrun game to date, and the definitive Shadowrun RPG experience available on PC. Now a standalone title with tons of new content & improvements!

item.title: Bus Simulator 27
item.description: Drive officially licensed buses from renowned manufacturers and manage your bus company to success. Felicia Bay’s public transportation system is counting on you!

item.title: Shadowrun Returns
item.description: The unique cyberpunk-meets-fantasy world of Shadowrun has gained a huge cult following since its creation nearly 25 years ago. Now, creator Jordan Weisman returns to the world of Shadowrun, modernizing this classic game setting as a single player, turn-based tactical RPG.

item.title: Shadowrun: Hong Kong - Extended Edition
item.description: Shadowrun: Hong Kong - Extended Edition is the capstone title in Harebrained Schemes' Shadowrun series - and now includes the all-new, 6+ hr Shadows of Hong Kong Bonus Campaign. Experience the most impressive Shadowrun RPG yet, hailed as one of the best cRPG / strategy games of 2015!

item.title: Squad Weapon Skins - Recon Team Pack
item.description: This pack contains 5 woodland weapon skins for the USMC faction.

item.title: Voidtrain - Big Catch
item.description: Catch fish aboard your train, upgrade your gear, and earn Scales with every catch to spend on fishing upgrades and train decor.

item.title: Gear.Club Unlimited 3 - Gear.Club Signature Pack
item.description: Get the Gear.Club Signature Pack and enjoy two exclusive liveries: the Honda S2000 GCU3 Edition and the BMW Z4 GCU Edition. Taking inspiration from Japanese culture, they will transform your cars into works of art!
